messages:
Kai Turner: Heads-up everyone — final review forms are due Friday 5pm PT. Two quick items: upload any supporting docs by Thursday noon PT, and we need an extra engineering reviewer for calibration panel Tue 104511:45am PT. Reply if you can join.

Maya Chen: Thanks @Kai. For clarity: attachments uploaded after Thu 12pm may not be anonymized in time for the panel. If that's unavoidable, note it in the tracker and DM people-ops.

Ravi Singh: I can cover the Tue panel for eng if you still need a reviewer.

Kai Turner: Awesome @Ravi Singh, added you. Also, small ask: if you have anyone on LOA returning within 2 days of the deadline, flag them in `/exceptions` now so we can pre-authorize a short extension.

HR Bot: Tip: use `/upload [employee-id] [link]` to attach evidence. Valid formats: .pdf, .docx, google links. Use `/exceptions add [employee-id] [reason]` to request extensions. See pinned docs: https://intranet.redwood/reviews-help.

Maya Chen: Reminder — reviewers will see last-year rating unless opted out. Please avoid anchoring; use the rubric examples linked in the prep folder. We'll circulate 3 anonymized practice packets Mon morning.

Kai Turner: Great, thank you. If anyone needs help converting files to PDF or redacting customer data, ping people-ops and we'll assist. :thumbsup:
